title: POTA NSW Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Maritime Container Services Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: POTA NSW Pty Ltd, a subsidiary of POTA Holdings Pty Ltd, proposed to acquire the container park business and the container transport business of Maritime Container Services Pty Ltd.
